preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.
There must be exactly n - 1 roads connecting the cities.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of days k needed to repair all roads.

postconditions.expression: sum(d_i for d_i in days) == len(roads)
postconditions.description: The total number of roads listed for repair over all days must equal the total number of roads.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= road <= len(roads) for day in days for road in day)
postconditions.description: All roads listed for repair on each day must be valid and within the range of the input roads.
